fitness_evaluation.note: Third week of Epoch X. Held the chassis exactly — bone field #f2ede1, ink body, cinnabar #b23a17 accent, Cormorant/Source Serif/JetBrains Mono — while the idea moved again: the census of stillnesses completes its turn from space to time. String (1D), plate (2D), room (3D) are joined by the beat (time): two near-identical voices whose sum cancels on a schedule, a node no place can hold. visual_strategy: Hold Epoch X's resonance chassis byte-for-byte on look — warm bone field, ink body, single cinnabar accent, editorial serif over mono — and deepen the instrument census into its fourth dimension: time. The new beat stage reuses the plate-dark material and the sand-and-ember language so the page stays one substance; only the physics is new.
weekly_reflection: The epoch's spine is now a complete ladder: one dimension (string), two (plate), three (room), and time (beat). Each stage speaks the same material — dark plate, sand, cinnabar nodes — so the page reads as one instrument examined four ways. The remaining frontier inside the obsession is combination: sympathetic coupling across instruments, or the page's own instruments beginning to answer each other. Fitness holds near the epoch's high without stagnation; the obsession lives.
palette_rationale: Deliberate monochrome: a warm bone-to-ink neutral scale carries the page and one cinnabar accent (#b23a17) carries all hue — the ember is reserved for nodes, silences, and the words that matter, which is exactly the obsession's claim that the still points decide everything.
